captions.detailed: This is a compact, benchtop-scale laboratory monocular microscope rendered in a beige-brown and black color scheme. It features a heavy rectangular base, a vertical metal pillar supporting a separate specimen stage assembly, and a swept arm that holds the upper optical body. The specimen stage is a flat black rectangular plate equipped with slide clips holding a transparent glass slide, while the optical body has a rotating objective turret with multiple lenses. For articulation, the optical body carriage slides vertically on the main column, the objective turret rotates continuously about its optical axis, the specimen stage slides left to right, and a small diaphragm lever rotates on a short pivot beneath the stage.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact laboratory monocular microscope. Ensure it has a heavy rectangular base, a vertical support column, a separate rectangular specimen stage with slide clips, a swept arm holding a cylindrical monocular head, and a rotating objective turret. Define appropriate prismatic joints for the vertical focus adjustment and horizontal stage movement, and continuous/revolute joints for the objective turret and the under-stage diaphragm lever.
captions.factory: The model is constructed as an ArticulatedObject. It starts with a base part defined by combining rectangular boxes for the heavy foot and a vertical cylinder for the pillar. The stage carriage is modeled using a flat box for the specimen stage with additional cylinders for the objective condenser and slide clips, attached via a prismatic joint to the main pillar. The optical body carriage is built with a swept arm structure (using boxes and cylinders), a cylindrical monocular tube, and a rotating objective turret carrying small cylinder lenses. The assembly is completed by defining articulations: a vertical prismatic joint for the optical body carriage, a continuous rotation joint for the objective turret, a horizontal prismatic joint for the stage, and a revolute joint for the diaphragm lever.
